title: Marine litter and plastic pollution assessment
claim: Plastic and solid waste pollution in coastal and mangrove areas degrades habitat quality and is best addressed through combined source reduction and monitoring of affected zones.
evidence_text: UNEP's assessment of marine litter identifies coastal and mangrove areas near population centres and aquaculture operations as hotspots for plastic and solid-waste accumulation, which degrades water quality and smothers benthic and root-zone habitat. UNEP recommends establishing monitoring zones that track waste accumulation and water-quality indicators over time to target clean-up and source-reduction efforts where they are most needed.
